sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.functional_impact_measured: NOT MEASURED in PMC12797715 (L1; construct described but no assay result reported). Independent support from PMC8093967 (L5): HEK293T cells transfected with HA-CSF1R-EGFP showed CSF1R ectodomain shedding in conditioned medium; Batimastat (ADAM inhibitor) blocked shedding and caused full-length CSF1R accumulation, confirming surface-expressed tagged protein undergoes normal ectodomain processing.
sites.rationale: L1 explicitly states the tag was inserted 'between 19 and 20 aa (after signal peptide)' in human full-length membrane-anchored CSF1R, making this a validated position. Sequential position 19 (G) is the last residue of the signal peptide (landmarks: SP 1-19); position 20 (I) is the first residue of the mature extracellular domain (landmarks: EC 20-517). The tag therefore sits at the mature N-terminus, 498 residues from the TM boundary (518), well clear of any structural constraint. L3/L4/L5 (PMC8093967) independently corroborate this topology with an HA-CSF1R-EGFP construct on the same 972-aa backbone, showing surface expression and preserved ectodomain shedding. Human full-length CSF1R (NM_001349736.2) cloned into pIRES2-EGFP; a GGGS linker, 6×His tag, and Flag tag were inserted between aa 19 and 20 (explicitly after the signal peptide), creating a membrane-anchored tagged construct. A second independent study (PMC8093967, L3/L4/L5) engineered HA-CSF1R-EGFP with N-terminal HA on the same full-length 972-aa human CSF1R backbone and demonstrated surface expression and ADAM-mediated ectodomain shedding in HEK293T cells.

sources.claim: Human full length CSF1R ( NM_001349736.2 ) was cloned into pIRES2-EGFP vectors, and a GGGS linker, 6×His tag and a Flag tag were inserted between 19 and 20 aa (after signal peptide).

literature_notes: L2 (PMC12797715) describes a C-terminal HA tag on mouse full-length CSF1R inserted before the stop codon. The C-terminus of CSF1R (residue 972) lies in the intracellular domain (landmarks: IC 539-972); this is not a surface tag site and is recorded in other_positions. L3/L4/L5 (PMC8093967) describe HA-CSF1R-EGFP where EGFP is fused at the C-terminus; this C-terminal EGFP is also intracellular and is recorded in other_positions. The N-terminal HA in HA-CSF1R-EGFP (L3/L4/L5) supports the same junction as L1 (after residue 19) but names no residue number; since L1 already provides a validated, residue-explicit anchor for this same position, no separate site entry is warranted. No ledger line supports any internal extracellular loop insertion in CSF1R.

literature_other_positions.note: Mouse full-length CSF1R with C-terminal GGGS-HA tag inserted before the stop codon; residue 972 (C) is in the intracellular domain (IC 539-972) — not a surface tag site.
HA-CSF1R-EGFP construct has EGFP fused at the C-terminus of full-length CSF1R; the C-terminus (residue 972, intracellular) carries the EGFP — not a surface tag site.
